items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: getting Dexter on the Lionel Hampton Band, which was the first band that Dexter Gordon ever worked with.

ctx.x: So we stayed there for about -- in Sapulpa for about four years and then he finally decided that it was time that he took me to the so-called "Land of the Free," where I could get a decent education and be a man. So we came to California in 1918, in the spring of 1918, right before -- the World War I was still going on then. I got into California just in time to catch the flu and almost died, was delirious for two, three or four weeks with the flu, which nobody knew anything about at that time because it was the…
Incidentally, my doctor at that time was a fellow by the name of Gordon. He was Dexter Gordon's father, which leads into another story that I could probably tell on.
(Inaudible). Well, you can tell it now if you want.
